profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Data Pipelines & APIs | AWS Expert | Technical Leadership & Mentoring
profile.summary:
I enjoy making complicated systems understandable—and helping teams become confident working with them.
My career has taken me from real-time software and aircraft engineering as a Navy civilian computer scientist, through cloud services at Rackspace, to digital retail at H-E-B. Working across those environments has taught me to look beyond an individual component: understand the purpose, follow the dependencies, and consider the people who will maintain what we build.
I’m a hands-on engineer who likes investigating difficult problems, questioning assumptions, and finding practical ways forward. I care about technical decisions that hold up in production and leave the next engineer with something they can understand and improve.
Teaching and mentoring are among the most rewarding parts of my work. I like exchanging ideas with experienced colleagues and helping newer engineers develop their judgment. Success means delivering useful software while building a team that can carry the work forward together.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop pipelines for product, store, assortment, inventory, coupon, and pricing data. Build APIs centered on coupon management and clipping, collaborating with teams responsible for offers, carts, product discovery, redemption, and personalization.
• Deliver product-data enhancements supporting dietary preferences and Central Market integration. Advance a phased migration from legacy Elasticsearch indexes, adding end-to-end integration tests and parallel processing to validate results before switchover.
• Guide AWS architecture, infrastructure as code, and production troubleshooting. Improve cross-account access to operational dashboards and logs, simplify shared network rules, and build automation for vulnerability assessment.
• Coordinate cross-team load testing for peak-traffic readiness, including modeling a fivefold traffic increase for the Super Bowl.
• Helped establish H-E-B’s DevOps capabilities and AWS foundations, building provisioning, networking, and access-management patterns supporting 80+ accounts. Earlier platform work included Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and CI/CD.
• Led engineering work to launch customer single sign-on in partnership with Security. Investigated credential-stuffing attacks and implemented device verification and session protections.
• Expanded OpenTelemetry observability and improved cloud efficiency through ARM migrations, storage cleanup, and ECS resource tuning.
• Mentor engineers through pairing, cloud study groups, technical workshops, and simulated incident Game Days.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a PCI-compliant user-management web application for AWS customers and customer-facing websites across the full software stack.
• Formed and led a team of four developers, delivering software across multiple business units.
• Developed the award-winning Support Drawer, integrating customer support tools into the cloud control panel.
• Integrated web analytics across business units and helped teams implement changes to customer chat services.
• Led the Cloud business unit’s summer intern program and mentored students and professionals through hackathons, meetups, and coding events.
• Presented at Texas A&M’s Engineering Industry Seminar for three semesters.

positions.title: Ranger
positions.description:
I came to Philmont with the position to-be-determined, but I was eager to spend my summer at the Boy Scout's premier high-adventure base in any capacity. After a chance run in with the Associate Chief Ranger on my first morning, I found myself in the best position you could hope for, Ranger. Scouts who visit may only remember one or two names after their trip, their burro and their Ranger (in that order), so it was a great honor for me to serve as a Ranger.

As Ranger, I welcomed crews to Philmont and prepared them for the trail. I accompanied crews for the first couple days of their trek, coaching them in camping and hiking techniques, care of the land and teamwork. I generally functioned as tour guide, mentor and friend for all the crews to which I was assigned. To sum up my experience, this may have been my best summer of my life.

honors.title: Gold Stevie Award
honors.description: The American Business Awards, also known as The Stevies, is the premier business awards program in the U.S.A. My team took home the Gold Stevie Award in the Web Service Solution category for the Rackspace Support Drawer. I was the principal software developer on this project.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Stevie Awards · Jan 2015

honors.title: Director’s Award
honors.description: This annual award recognizes a team within the Air Vehicle Engineering Community that exhibits team accomplishments and significant achievements that exemplify teamwork, technical acumen, and overall solutions-oriented approaches to customer support.
honors.issuer: Issued by NAVAIR Air Vehicle Engineering Department · Jan 2013

volunteerExperiences.description: SoHacks is a 24-hour coding marathon held annually in San Antonio. It is one of the largest hackathons in the country aimed specifically at high school students. I have been a mentor at SoHacks since it began in 2014. As a mentor, I help to teach and guide students as they work on their projects. I have also led workshops, teaching beginners to build websites. This past year, I organized a team of 7 other software developers from HEB to join me as a mentor. I am already looking forward to SoHacks 5 in 2018!
